verdicts.reason: A: the pink CTA wraps badly, leaving 'THE' alone on its own line, so the block runs four ragged lines from the top edge to the bottom edge of the canvas. The heart-and-hand art is shrunk to a tiny smudge squeezed against the CTA, and the five lines of contact text are jammed against the top and bottom edges. B: the CTA wraps more cleanly into three lines, but 'AND BE THE' nearly touches the contact column, the hand is cut off by the bottom edge, and the contact text is just as cramped. In both, the URL floats on its own and the CTA is about as large as the headline, so the headline doesn't stand out.
